premises.text: Dynamic pricing allows stores to change prices rapidly and often without consumer awareness
premises.evidence_span: stores are taking advantage of this psychology by changing prices, by getting you to pay more without you realizing it

premises.text: Consumers are losing significant amounts of money due to complex price adjustment policies
premises.evidence_span: we estimate that online consumers are leaving $10 billion on the table every year

premises.text: Paribus automates the process of claiming money back from price drops
premises.evidence_span: Paribus is a web app that gets you the money you're owed effortlessly

premises.text: Paribus uses email receipts to track purchases and file claims automatically
premises.evidence_span: It scans your inbox receipts, tracks the prices on what you bought, and when they drop, automatically files claims to get you paid

premises.text: Paribus ensures user data security while processing claims
premises.evidence_span: Paribus does not live in your inbox. We place customized web hooks to pull receipts and store communications based on subject and sender alone

premises.text: Paribus charges a fee only after saving money for the user
premises.evidence_span: The only time that Paribus earns is after we save you money first

value.text: Consumers can recover money from price drops effortlessly

notes: No separate premises for beta member savings and store coverage as they support the same premise.
